mainEntity.name: What design features should I include in a backyard home for aging parents?

acceptedAnswer.text: A successful multigenerational suite balances accessibility, privacy, and long-term convenience. Critical features include zero-threshold walk-in showers with grab-bar backing, wider doorways, and single-level flooring to prevent trip hazards. Providing separate climate control allows occupants to adjust room temperature independently from the main house. Incorporating dedicated sound-dampening insulation inside shared or exterior walls ensures both households enjoy quiet daily living while staying close together.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include walk-in showers, wider doorways, single-level flooring, independent climate controls, and sound-insulating drywall to ensure safety, comfort, and privacy.
